title: Hangboard Protocol Load Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hangboard:protocol
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(load_kg) as total_value avg(hang_seconds) as avg_duration count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Summarizes hangboard protocol load by month so you can review season-to-date volume without digging through individual sessions.
value: A monthly rollup is useful for spotting big directional changes and for keeping a simple log of a long season.
implementation: Retain at least a season of history so month-over-month comparisons stay meaningful.
visualization: Column chart of monthly totals with average session duration overlaid.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the bigger month-by-month picture for hangboard protocol load instead of one session at a time.
